Part-Time Shift.name: Part-Time Shift
Part-Time Shift.questStatement: Kiyashi Shopping Mall is hiring for the spring rush, and you have a shift: a food-court counter, a shoe-store stockroom or the information desk, whichever your life put you in. The manager is stretched, the regulars are particular, and half the customers have Quirks that do inconvenient things in public. Today's shift is going to go wrong in some small, very Quirk-filled way. Keep the job anyway.
Part-Time Shift.mainObjective: Get through a shift gone wrong at Kiyashi Shopping Mall and keep your job.

completionCondition.query: The PC has finished a shift at Kiyashi Shopping Mall that went wrong, has dealt with the trouble, and the manager has kept, warned or fired the PC.

Part-Time Shift.questDesignBrief: Everyday Quirk-society comedy with small stakes that matter. Pick one or two problems: a customer whose sneeze sets off the sprinklers, a toddler who floats merchandise to the ceiling, a heteromorph customer a coworker refuses to serve, a delivery that does not match its invoice. Quirk law binds the PC: helping with a Quirk in public can still earn a reprimand. Gentle Criminal and La Brava may sit over tea in the Food Court, harmless today. No hero needs to appear; this is an ordinary life. Failure: lost wages, a warning or a firing, never danger beyond a scrape.
